title: french far left leader melenchon seen reaching presidential runoff poll shows 2026 08 24
text: PARIS, Aug 24 (Reuters) - French far-left leader Jean-Luc Melenchon is seen as the most likely rival to far-right candidate Marine ​Le Pen in next year's presidential run-off, a ‌Monday poll showed, underlining a deeply polarised electorate as Emmanuel Macron's presidency draws to a close.
